preamble: Retroflexion of the alveolar tap [ɾ] to the retroflex flap [ɽ], with the tongue tip curled back so that it strikes the postalveolar region. It occurs as an allophone of the tap phoneme. Some European Portuguese speakers, including in word-final position (falar [fɐˈläɽ]), and some caipira and sertanejo speakers in Brazil use [ɽ] for /ɾ/.

languageExamples.language: Portuguese (some European, caipira and sertanejo speakers)

context: Free or speaker-dependent variation of the tap /ɾ/
